member.name: T:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode
member.summary: Defines how samples outside the valid data range are synthesized when a smoothing kernel overlaps the boundaries of the input sequence.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.Symmetric
member.summary: Mirror the data at the edges (… 3, 2, 1 | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 | 5, 4, 3 …). Provides continuous first derivative at the boundary for smoother response.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.Replicate
member.summary: Clamp to the nearest edge value (… 1, 1, 1 | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 | 5, 5, 5 …). Simpler and slightly faster; may flatten edge dynamics.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.ZeroPad
member.summary: Treat all samples outside the range as zero. Can introduce edge attenuation (energy loss) near the boundaries.

member.name: F:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode.Adaptive
member.summary: Slide a full window of length W fully inside [0 … N - 1] (asymmetric near edges). This preserves a full window without synthesizing out-of-range samples.

member.name: M:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.ComputeMediansByRadius(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double},System.Boolean,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.IProgress{System.Int32},AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode)
member.summary: Computes running medians using a radius R (converted internally to odd width W = 2R + 1). Validates inputs and forwards to the width-based overload.

member.name: M:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.ComputeMedians(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double},System.Boolean,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.IProgress{System.Int32},AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.BoundaryMode)

member.summary: Return a value from data at logical index idx using the requested boundary mode. Symmetric uses periodic reflection with 64-bit period 2 * (n - 1) to guarantee in-range mapping.

member.name: M:AvocadoSmoothie.Barista.SignatureMedian.GetWindowMedian(System.Double[],System.Int32)
member.summary: Computes the median of the first elements in . The method sorts that prefix in-place (indices [0 .. length - 1]) and returns: - For odd : the middle element. - For even : the arithmetic mean of the two central elements.
